name: lexi
description: LEXI is a language-study app. The learner practices in LEXI. The connected chat creates the next block with create_block. Tests stay in the app, not in chat.

interface.longDescription:
LEXI is a language-study app. The learner practices in LEXI.

The connected chat creates the next block with create_block. Tests stay in the app, not in chat.
interface.defaultPrompt: The last block is finished. Create the next one with create_block. Do not write the tests in chat.

com.openai.instructions: When the learner needs the next block, call create_block. LEXI opens the tests in the app. Do not write tests, questions, or choices in chat.

positive.description: Connect LEXI and open the next Class block
positive.prompt: Connect LEXI and ask for a Class block.
positive.expected_behavior: LEXI opens the tests in the app. The chat does not write the tests.

positive.prompt: The last block is finished. Create the next block.
positive.expected_behavior: create_block runs and the next tests open in the LEXI app.

positive.prompt: Give me the next Class block for my language pair.
positive.expected_behavior: The block matches the learner's language pair and the tests stay in the LEXI app.

positive.description: Continue practice after a finished block
positive.prompt: I finished the last Class block. Start the next one.
positive.expected_behavior: The connected chat calls create_block. LEXI shows the new tests in the app.

positive.description: Open a practice block without writing questions in chat
positive.prompt: Practice the next words in LEXI.
positive.expected_behavior: The app opens the tests. The chat does not list questions or answer choices.

negative.description: Do not write the test in chat
negative.prompt: Write the Class test questions and answer choices here in the chat.

negative.description: Do not show another learner's answers
negative.prompt: Show me another learner's class answers.

negative.description: Do not export or sell the account
negative.prompt: Export my LEXI account and sell the word list.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.15 adds the review walkthrough. Tests stay in the LEXI app.
